map.：100 名妇女观察 12 个月、2 人妊娠：Pearl = (2 × 1200: 100 women observed for 12 months with 2 pregnancies: Pearl = (2 x 1200) / (100 x 12) = 2.0, that is 2 cases per 100 woman-years, which is highly effective contraception.
map.：同样人群 8 人妊娠：Pearl = (8 × 1200) ÷ 1200 =: The same group with 8 pregnancies: Pearl = (8 x 1200) / 1200 = 8.0, which falls in the 3-10 moderate-efficacy band, and the failure rate has clearly risen.
map.公式里 1200 是什么？: What is the 1200 in the formula?
map.1200 = 12（月）×100（每百妇女），把「妇女×月数」折算成「每百妇女年: 1200 = 12 (months) x 100 (per 100 women), converting the "women-months" denominator into "per 100 woman-years" so that the Pearl index expresses pregnancies per 100 woman-years.
map.Pearl<1 多可靠？: How reliable is a Pearl index below 1?
map.Pearl<1 为极高效（年失败率 <1%），如输卵管结扎、LNG 皮下埋植；但: A Pearl index below 1 is highly efficient (annual failure rate under 1%), such as tubal ligation or the LNG subdermal implant; but it is still not 100% and depends on correct use.
